description: Source code for SX127x LoRa radio driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, GPIO handling, and SPI communication.

methods.name: SX127xCheckRfFrequency
methods.description: Checks if the given RF frequency is valid (currently always returns true).

methods.name: SX127xGetBoardTcxoWakeupTime
methods.description: Returns the board-specific TCXO wakeup time.

methods.name: SX127xSetAntSwLowPower
methods.description: Sets antenna switch to low power state.

methods.name: SX127xSetAntSw
methods.description: Configures antenna switch based on operation mode.

methods.name: SX127xReset
methods.description: Performs a reset of the SX127x device.

methods.name: SX127xIoIrqInit
methods.description: Initializes GPIO IRQs for DIO pins.

methods.name: SX127xWriteBuffer
methods.description: Writes data buffer to specified register address.

methods.name: SX127xReadBuffer
methods.description: Reads data buffer from specified register address.

methods.name: SX127xSetRfTxPower
methods.description: Sets the RF transmit power level.

methods.name: SX127xGetDio1PinState
methods.description: Returns the state of DIO1 pin.
